verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a Linux distribution, not itself an agent, so shipping an official MCP server for agents to control the system is a fair axis. The evidence shows only the omarchy CLI being useful to agents, bundled agent harnesses, and agent skills. These are adjacent features, not an official MCP server, and no MCP server is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
